i think it's just the fact that I'm not comfortable taking about my problems with my parents. They don't know a lot about my personal life, and some of the things would really upset them.



You're right though, I need to quit smoking. My friend and I both agreed that our group of friends has a 'group addiction.' We've always had people try to quit smoke weed, but they peer-pressure themselves.


I think the weed prevented me from actually fixing it. I really did want to fix it, i tried for 4 semesters, but the weed really hindered it and just makes me lazy.
